chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَلِّمُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ مَا يَنْفَعُهُمْ بِهِ، لَا يَغْلِبُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُرْجِئَةُ بِرَأْيِهَا

translations.en: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Teach your children that which will benefit them, so that the Murjia should not overpower them with their speculative opinions.

en.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs parents to educate their children with beneficial knowledge to protect them from the influence of the Murjia sect's theological speculations. This highlights the importance of early religious education in shaping correct creed.
en.seo_question: What did Imam Ali teach about educating children against theological errors?

key_terms.الْمُرْجِئَةُ: The Murjia, a theological sect known for delaying judgment on faith and deeds
key_terms.رَأْيِهَا: Their speculative opinions or theological reasoning
key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali (peace be upon him)
